name: Yarn Embroidery Kids Backpack
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from premium corduroy fabric, this kids backpack offers a soft texture, durable construction, and comfortable everyday use.

- The sturdy material is lightweight yet resilient enough to withstand daily school, travel, and play activities.

- Featuring high-quality zippers, reinforced stitching, and adjustable shoulder straps, it is designed with both comfort and durability in mind.

 

  •  Sizes & Dimensions:

Designed to provide ample storage while remaining lightweight and easy for children to carry:

- Height: 16 in (40.64 cm)

- Width: 11 in (27.94 cm)

- Depth: 5 in (12.7 cm)

 

  • Embroidery Technology

- Personalized using beautifully woven cotton rope embroidery, creating a unique handcrafted appearance with a raised, textured finish. 

- Unlike traditional printing, the yarn embroidery design adds dimension, durability, and a premium customized look that stands out. 

- Available in two font styles to create a truly one-of-a-kind backpack.

- The backpack also comes with decorative charm accessories attached, adding a fun and unique touch.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

Perfect for a variety of everyday activities, including:

- School and preschool use

- Day trips and family outings

- Carrying books, snacks, toys, and personal belongings

- Travel and overnight stays

- Organizing daily essentials with convenient front and side pockets

- The adjustable shoulder straps provide a comfortable fit that grows with your child.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

This personalized yarn embroidery kids backpack makes a thoughtful and practical gift for children. Ideal for birthdays, back-to-school season, Christmas, Easter, first-day-of-school celebrations, and other special occasions. Adding a child's name creates a meaningful keepsake they'll love to carry every day.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xYarn Embroidery Kids Backpack

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • When submitting an order, a mockup must be provided to indicate the placement of the charm accessories.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
